title: Look here for next energy sector merger: Analyst
主要内容: Analysts are closely watching the energy sector for potential mergers, with Apache Corp and Anadarko Petroleum being highlighted as possible targets. Matthew Beesley, head of global equities at Henderson Global Investors, noted that while the $70 billion takeover of BG Group by Royal Dutch Shell has sparked speculation, it may not signal a broader trend. He emphasized that the energy sector's consolidation is unlikely to repeat, citing challenges such as BP's financial issues and the difficulty of finding attractive targets in North America. Beesley also pointed out the uncertainty in assessing deals due to fluctuating oil prices, with some analysts predicting a rebound to $80 in the future, while the futures market remains at $60 to $65. The focus is on deals that allow energy firms to avoid issuing equity and maintain dividend policies.
